steps.label: Historical flow only. The current read-only Gateway case does not include Workspace repository reads. See issue #2752.
Open existing authorization request with exact bounded Workspace intent
Review exact repo and operation with current cookie and antiforgery token
Create an owner-bound selection through the existing Repo App connection
Exact loopback GET callback carries OAuth code and state only
Exchange code over HTTPS with the S256 verifier
Return OAuth tokens and private workspace_selection response parameter
Selection is not part of the callback, OAuth tokens, logs, vault or evidence. Each repository read gets a new selection.
Read refs, tree and file with the required selection header
Return bounded data after current project and repository owner checks
Run B receipts, child startup, and terminal cleanup are separate flows; this check does not exercise them.
